rules.en: ◆A Full Capacity Gift will be randomly sent to Transcenders who attend the banquet after the banquest is full. The gift will be distributed via mails.
◆ After gathering enough banquet materials, a banquet can be held. Banquets can also be held after encountering special events and receiving Invitation Cards.
◆ Invitation Cards to banquets have a validity period; banquets cannot be held after an Invitation Card has expired.
◆ After a banquet ends players will obtain Banquet Coins and Popularity.
◆ Specific family members and Fellows can increase the amount of Popularity received from banquets.
◆ Holding Dinner Parties will grant 20% increased Popularity.
◆ Players must bring a gift when attending other people's banquets. The higher the quality of the gift, the more Banquet Coins and Popularity will be received.
◆ Improving a Transcender's Rank and meeting certain Fellows and family members can increase the Popularity and Banquet Coins obtained from attending banquets.
